strings.文件读取失败，请重新选择: Could not read the file. Choose it again.
strings.请选择系统文件管理器中的文件: Choose a file from the system file picker
strings.下次打开时回到上次游戏: Reopen the last game on launch
strings.游戏进度会自动保存到本机。返回游戏时可选择继续；此开关只控制打开应用后的页面。: Progress is saved on this device automatically. You can resume when returning to a game; this option only changes the launch screen.
strings.备份包含游戏进度、历史记录和主题设置。换机前请先导出；导入也支持玩伴小屋的旧版游: Back up progress, records and theme settings before changing devices. Older USER_HOUSE game backups can also be imported.
strings.数据保存在当前设备，卸载应用会删除本机存档。: Data stays on this device. Uninstalling the app deletes its local saves.
strings.单人游戏与人机挑战均可离线游玩。: Solo games and computer challenges work offline.
strings.从下载页安装新版本即可保留存档。请使用同一来源的更新包，无需卸载。: Install an update from the same download source to keep saves. There is no need to uninstall.
strings.请重新打开应用。存档仍保留在本机。: Please reopen the app. Your saves are still on this device.
strings.普通：点对变淡｜盲点：不变色: Normal: fade completed numbers · Blind: no fading
strings.下拉可刷新游戏列表，存档保留在本机。: Pull down to refresh the game list. Saves stay on this device.
strings.安装新版玩吧 App 后，可在此更新游戏内容。: Install the latest Nookcade app to update game content here.
strings.请先返回游戏列表再安装更新: Return to the game list before installing.
strings.存档未完成，请稍后重试: Saving has not finished. Try again shortly.
strings.回退到上一版游戏内容，保留当前存档？: Return to the previous game content and keep current saves?
strings.更新暂不可用，请稍后重试: Updates are temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
strings.秒后继续上次进度: seconds until the saved game resumes
strings.拖动方块到棋盘，行列满格即消除: Drag a shape onto the board; complete rows or columns to clear them.
strings.击任务靶选择 → 上坡接受任务: Select at mission targets → take the ramp to accept
strings.长按约 3 秒松手发射 · 方向键控制挡板 · 连续震台会 TILT。高清模式保: Hold about 3 seconds, then release to launch. Arrow keys control the flippers; repeated nudging causes TILT. HD mode uses a redrawn table with the original engine ball and mechanisms. Turn HD off for the classic display.
A complete table and redrawn art are included. You can also choose original PINBALL.DAT/CADET.DAT and sound*.wav files from this device. Imported files stay in this browser; changing them starts a new game.
strings.达成分数过关 · 剩余步数越多星级越高: Reach the target; more moves left earn more stars.
strings.多连制造特效 · 初始 30 金币可使用道具: Long matches make specials. Start with 30 coins for tools.
strings.点选或滑动交换 · 四连清线 / 五连彩虹 / L、T 爆弹: Tap or swipe to swap. Four: line clear · Five: rainbow · L/T: bomb.
strings.金币为本局道具奖励 · 两颗特效交换可组合: Coins are tools for this round. Swap two specials to combine them.
strings.点击牌选中，再点击目标；列内红黑交替递减，收牌区从 A 到 K。 双击／快速连点: Select a card, then a destination. Build descending alternating colors; foundations go A to K. Double-tap an exposed card to send it home. Safe auto-home preserves useful cards. Undo also reverses automatic moves from that turn.
strings.角色想好了一个四位数。输入四位不重复数字，提示会显示“数字对几个、位置对几个”。: A four-digit code is ready. Enter four different digits; hints show how many digits match and how many are correctly placed.
strings.猜红黑决定本局先手: Guess red or black to decide who starts.
strings.一次收取全部安全牌；双击或快速连点单张牌则只按同花色 A 到 K 判断: Home all safe cards. Double-tap one card to check only its suit and A-to-K order.
strings.每次有效移动后自动收取安全牌，与该次移动一起撤回: Home safe cards after each valid move; undo reverses the whole turn.
strings.已选中：点击目标空当、列或同花色收牌区。 双击／快速连点同一张露出的牌可归位。安: Selected: tap a free cell, column or matching foundation. Double-tap an exposed card to send it home. Safe auto-home keeps useful cards; undo reverses automatic moves from the same turn.
strings.降低画布精度与装饰特效，减少绘制负担。: Lower canvas resolution and fewer decorative effects reduce rendering load.
strings.平衡画面清晰度与绘制负担，适合日常游玩。: Balance visual clarity and rendering load for everyday play.
strings.提高支持游戏的画布精度，保留完整装饰特效。: Use higher canvas resolution in supported games and keep all decorative effects.
strings.画布精度在下次进入游戏时生效；游戏速度和操作规则保持一致。: Canvas resolution applies the next time you enter a game. Game speed and controls stay the same.
strings.游戏内容已是最新: Game content is up to date
strings.发现可用的游戏内容更新: A game content update is available
strings.下载完成，回到首页后可安装: Download complete. Return home to install.
strings.新版内容未能启动，已恢复上一版本和更新前存档: The new content could not start. The previous version and pre-update saves were restored.
strings.已回到上一内容版本，当前存档保留: Restored the previous content version. Current saves are preserved.
strings.该版本上次启动未成功，请等待修复版本: This version failed to start previously. Please wait for a fixed release.
strings.该版本上次启动失败，请等待修复版本: This version failed to start previously. Please wait for a fixed release.
strings.可用空间不足，请清理空间后重试: Not enough storage. Free up space and try again.
strings.没有可回退的内容版本: No previous content version is available.
strings.更新候选已变化，请重新检查: The available update changed. Check again.
strings.拒绝过旧或重复发布序号的内容: The content has an outdated or duplicate release number.
strings.下载内容过大: The download exceeds its allowed size.
strings.下载不完整，请重试: The download is incomplete. Try again.
strings.下载跳转离开了受信任的 GitHub 发布服务: The download redirected outside the trusted GitHub release service.
strings.GitHub 暂时限制请求，请稍后再试: GitHub is temporarily limiting requests. Try again later.
strings.更新前存档过大: The pre-update save is too large.
strings.请先回到首页并保存游戏: Return home and save your game first.
strings.操作未完成，请重试: The operation did not complete. Try again.
strings.更新缺少资源包: The update is missing a resource pack.
strings.正在移动游戏，松开完成排序: Moving game. Release to finish reordering.
strings.在游戏列表点收藏，即可在这里找到。: Add favorites from the game list to find them here.
strings.收藏和排序未能保存，请检查设备存储空间: Could not save favorites and order. Check your device storage.
strings.备份包含游戏进度、历史记录、收藏和排序。换机前请先导出；导入也支持玩伴小屋的旧版: Backups include game progress, records, favorites and game order. Export a backup before changing devices. Older USER_HOUSE game backups can also be imported.
strings.已导出游戏进度、记录、收藏和排序。: Game progress, records, favorites and game order exported.
strings.备份中包含的游戏进度、记录、收藏和排序将覆盖对应的当前数据。写入失败会保留原数据: The backup will replace the corresponding game progress, records, favorites and game order. If saving fails, your original data will be kept. Import this backup?
strings.吃彩点变长，巧妙走位，让对手撞上你的身体。所有对手均由本机 AI 控制。: Eat dots to grow. Steer so rivals hit your body. All rivals are AI on this device.
strings.竞技模式：左手摇杆，右手长按加速。经典模式保留原有规则和存档。: Arena: steer on the left, hold boost on the right. Classic keeps the original rules and saves.
strings.左手转向 · 右手加速 · 碰到其他蛇身即淘汰: Left: steer · Right: boost · Avoid other snakes
strings.方块之间，见招拆招: Every block is a new move
strings.连续消行向对手发送干扰行。暂存、预览和落点提示，帮你规划下一步。对手由本机 AI: Clear rows to send garbage to your rival. Use hold, previews and the landing guide to plan ahead. Your opponent is AI on this device.
strings.经典模式保留原有规则和存档。: Classic keeps the original rules and saves.
strings.连续消行向 AI 发送干扰行；长按方向或软降可连续操作。: Clear rows to attack. Hold a direction or soft drop to repeat.
strings.暂存方块调整顺序，轮廓显示落点。: Use hold to change the order. The outline shows the landing position.

templates.title: {game} · {label}
templates.countdown: seconds until the saved game resumes
templates.numberHint: Tap 1 → {value} in order. Correct numbers fade; mistakes cost points.
templates.githubDownloadFailure: GitHub download failed ({value}). Offline content is preserved.

tetris.title: Falling Blocks
tetris.rules: Move and rotate blocks to complete rows. Use the ghost landing guide, hold, three-piece preview, soft drop and hard drop. In offline AI battles, line clears cancel or send garbage. Marathon and 40-line challenges are also available; old saves continue in classic mode.

snake.title: Snake
snake.rules: Steer with the left stick and hold boost on the right. Eat dots to grow and make AI rivals hit your body. Hitting another snake or the boundary ends your run. Play endless or 3-minute arena; classic grid and old saves remain available.

game2048.rules: Swipe to slide every tile. Equal numbers merge on contact. Choose a 4×4 board or a relaxed 6×6 board whose final score is halved. Tiles can grow to 65,536.

watermelon.title: Fruit Merge
watermelon.rules: Choose a drop position. Matching fruits merge when they touch. Keep the fruit pile below the warning line.

memory.title: Memory Pairs
memory.rules: Turn over two cards at a time. Keep matching pairs and remember the others. Match every pair using as few turns as possible.

jump.title: Platform Hop
jump.rules: Hold to charge, then release to jump. Land on the next platform; aim for its center for a better result. Missing a platform ends the run.

plank.title: Bridge Builder
plank.rules: Hold the screen or Space to grow a bridge, then release to lower it. The bridge must reach the next pillar without going past it.

sudoku.title: Sudoku
sudoku.rules: Use 1–9 once in each row, column and 3×3 box. Choose a cell or a number first. Keep 3×3 pencil notes and undo or redo edits. Read a hint before applying it. Options include candidate filling, note cleanup and solution checking. New puzzles have a unique solution; four difficulty levels are based on blank counts. Pause and keyboard controls are available.

minesweeper.title: Minesweeper
minesweeper.rules: Choose 9×9/10 mines, 12×12/25 mines, or 16×16/50 mines. Switch between reveal and flag. A number shows neighboring mines. When its neighboring flag count matches it, tap the number to reveal the remaining neighbors; incorrect flags can cause a loss.

shuerte.title: Number Focus
shuerte.rules: Tap the numbers in ascending order. Choose a 4×4, 5×5 or 6×6 board. Blind mode does not fade completed numbers. Mistakes cost points; hint, focus and shuffle tools can help.

uyangle.title: Triple Tile Stack
uyangle.rules: Tap uncovered tiles to place them in the seven-slot tray. Three matching tiles clear together. Do not fill the tray without a match. Endless mode adds more layers as you clear tiles.

screw.title: Screw Sort
screw.rules: Tap visible screws to sort them into matching toolboxes. Each box takes three screws; unmatched colors use the five-slot tray. Remove upper panels to reach lower screws. Choose a finite board or endless batches.

popstar.title: Pop Stars
popstar.rules: Tap connected groups of two or more matching stars. Larger groups score more. Easy mode has no move limit; hard mode limits moves. Meet the cumulative target to advance. Remaining stars and unused moves affect the bonus.

paopao.title: Bubble Shooter
paopao.rules: Hold or drag to aim and release to shoot. Bounce off side walls and connect three matching bubbles. Unsupported bubbles fall for extra points. Rows descend after several shots; keep all bubbles above the red line. Each round starts with five bombs.

pinball.title: Space Cadet Pinball
pinball.rules: Hold the launch control for about three seconds, then release. Use left and right flippers. Hit mission targets, ramps, wormholes and fuel lanes to score and rank up. Excessive nudging causes TILT. Three balls per game. Zoom and HD/classic display are available. Returning on the same page resumes the live table; a reload restores the score, normal ball count and rank with a new ball.

match3.title: Gem Match
match3.rules: Swap adjacent gems to match three. Four in a line create a line clearer, five create a rainbow, and L/T shapes create bombs. Combine special gems. Classic, ice and endless modes keep separate progress. Earn round rewards for tools; invalid swaps do not cost moves. Ending or restarting a round resets its rewards.

freecell.title: FreeCell
freecell.rules: Move all 52 cards to the four foundations in suit order from Ace to King. Tableau stacks descend in alternating colors. Empty free cells and columns determine how many cards can move together. Undo and hints are available. Use safe auto-home or double-tap an eligible card to send it home.

zuma.title: Marble Trail
zuma.rules: Match 3 or more touching marbles of one color. Hold anywhere on the board to aim, then release to shoot. Tap the frog or SWAP to exchange your two marbles. Matching ends pull together across a gap and can trigger another match. Fill the gold meter, then clear every remaining marble. Shoot coins and match marked marbles to activate explosion, slow, reverse or precision. You have three lives.

watersort.title: Water Sort
watersort.rules: Tap a source bottle and a destination. Pour a top color into an empty bottle or the same top color when there is space. Sort each bottle into one color to advance through endless levels.

game1010.title: Block Grid
game1010.rules: Place the available shapes on the board. Fill a row or column to clear it. Plan space for the next pieces; the game ends when no available shape fits.

turkey.title: Sliding Blocks
turkey.rules: Slide blocks horizontally to fill rows. Cleared rows let blocks fall and can trigger chain reactions. Keep the rising board from filling up.

spider.title: Endless Spider
spider.rules: Build descending card sequences and complete King-to-Ace runs to remove them. Move legal runs between columns and deal new cards when needed. Choose a suit difficulty; clearing cards allows continued play.

linklink.title: Tile Connect
linklink.rules: Select matching tiles that can be connected with a path of at most two turns. Clear the board before time runs out. Hint and shuffle tools can help.

ludo.title: Ludo
ludo.rules: Roll the die and move a legal piece along the track toward home. Racing, captures and landing positions matter. Play against the local computer opponent.

guessnumber.title: Code Breaker
guessnumber.rules: Guess a four-digit code with no repeated digits. Each guess tells you how many digits are present and how many are in the correct position.

wordguess.title: Word Riddles
wordguess.rules: Read the clues and type the hidden word. Reveal more clues or show the answer, then continue to the next question. This release uses the original Chinese word bank; language settings translate controls, not puzzle answers.

tictactoe.title: Tic-Tac-Toe
tictactoe.rules: Place a mark in an empty square. Make three in a row, column or diagonal before the computer does. A full board without a line is a draw.

gomoku.title: Gomoku
gomoku.rules: Place black and white stones in turns. Standard mode is won by making a line of five. Endless mode adds limited reserves and capture rules; its counters show the stones remaining and captured.

territory.title: Dots and Boxes
territory.rules: Take turns drawing edges between dots. Completing the fourth side of a square claims it and gives you another turn. When every edge is drawn, the player with more squares wins.

oldmaid.title: Old Maid
oldmaid.rules: Take turns drawing cards and discarding pairs. Avoid being the last player holding the unmatched card.

reversi.title: Reversi
reversi.rules: Place a disc so your color encloses one or more opposing discs in a straight line. Those discs flip. If you have no legal move, pass. More discs at the end wins.

bombnumber.title: Number Bomb
bombnumber.rules: Choose a number within the current range. Each safe guess narrows the range. Avoid choosing the hidden bomb number.

connect4d.title: Four in a Row
connect4d.rules: Choose a column on the 7×7 board. Your piece drops into its lowest empty square. Take turns and make four matching pieces in a horizontal, vertical or diagonal line.

draughts.title: Chinese Checkers
draughts.rules: Move your pieces into the opposite camp. Step to adjacent empty positions or jump over pieces, chaining legal jumps. Plan the final arrangement inside the target camp.

blackjack.title: Blackjack
blackjack.rules: Draw cards to approach 21 without going over, or stand and let the computer play. Aces can count as 1 or 11. Win rounds to reach the current level target.

westernchess.title: Chess
westernchess.rules: Move pieces according to chess rules and protect your king. Checkmate wins. Legal move highlights and the local computer help you play through each position. Castling and automatic promotion to queen are supported; en passant is not. Stalemate, the 50-move rule and a simplified repetition check can produce a draw.

chinesechess.title: Xiangqi
chinesechess.rules: Move pieces according to Xiangqi rules and protect your general. The river, palace and cannon captures affect legal moves. Checkmate the opposing general to win.
